# KafkaMultipleActiveControllers

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| critical | kafka | [kafka-kraft](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-kraft/) | 2m / 30s |

**Summary:** Cluster <kafka_cluster> reports more than one active controller

Several nodes believe they are the active controller for longer than an election takes. Usually a network partition between controller nodes; check the KRaft dashboard and controller logs.

## Impact

Conflicting metadata decisions are fenced by epochs, but clients and brokers may see flapping leadership.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · KRaft Controller & Quorum: Raft epoch and leader per node — do nodes disagree?
2. Look for a network partition between controller nodes.

## Mitigation

- Heal the network partition; the node with the stale epoch resigns automatically.

## Expression

```promql
sum by (kafka_cluster) (kafka_controller_kafkacontroller_activecontrollercount) > 1
```
